about: Asset slot contract. Pages ask for a slot id through resolve.js and never name a file or a provider. Emblem and theme slots are keyed by the icon kind the build picks for a box (icons_data.py), never by an app's name, so the art fits any vault. Every slot must be filled by the builtin provider; other providers may fill any subset. 'accepts' lists the forms a provider may supply, in the resolver's preference order. Assets carry identity and atmosphere only: no diagram, label or data is ever baked into an asset.

slots.for: Icon for a box whose icon kind is learning (a course, a tutor, a teaching service): map stations, strip headers, sequence-diagram lifelines
Icon for a box whose icon kind is news (articles, a feed, editorial content)
Icon for a box whose icon kind is trading (a broker, a market, an exchange)
Icon for a box whose icon kind is pricing (prices, quotes, fares, tariffs)
